source: Labour Party 2024 General Election Manifesto + subsequent policy announcements

promises.evidence: NHS waiting list hit 7.7M in Jan 2026, up from 7.5M at election. A&E waits at record highs.
Some additional capacity created but far short of 40K/week target. Junior doctor strikes disrupted progress.
No recruitment programme announced. Mental health services continue to deteriorate.

promises.text: Create Great British Energy (public energy company)
promises.evidence: GB Energy Bill passed. HQ in Aberdeen. But no generating capacity yet and no impact on bills.

promises.text: Not raise taxes on working people
promises.evidence: Employer NI raised from 13.8% to 15% in Oct 2025 Budget. Threshold lowered. IFS estimates £25B tax rise.
ASB figures continue to rise. Community payback orders down. No new ASB legislation introduced.
Police numbers fell by 2,100 in 2025. No recruitment funding announced in Budget.
Housing starts fell to 135K in 2025 (need 300K/yr). Planning reforms stuck in Lords.
Renters Rights Bill introduced but still in parliamentary passage. Not yet law.

promises.text: No increase in income tax, NI, or VAT
promises.evidence: Employer NI increased. Fiscal drag freezing thresholds = stealth income tax rise. CGT raised.
GBR Bill passed. Some franchises taken in-house as contracts expire. Full nationalisation years away.

promises.text: Set up a National Wealth Fund
promises.evidence: National Wealth Fund announced with £7.3B. Some investments made in green industries.
Employment Rights Bill introduced. Still in committee stage. Unions say it's been watered down.
Channel crossings up 28% in 2025 vs 2024. Smash the gangs rhetoric but no operational breakthrough.
Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Bill introduced. Command established but crossings still rising.
Rwanda scheme cancelled on day 1 of government.
State pension rose 4.1% in April 2026 under triple lock.

promises.text: Free breakfast clubs in every primary school
promises.evidence: Pilot started in 750 schools. Full rollout not yet funded.
Teacher recruitment targets missed again in 2025. Retention crisis worsening.

promises.text: Add VAT to private school fees
promises.evidence: 20% VAT on private school fees from Jan 2025. Some schools passed costs to parents.

promises.text: Halve violence against women and girls
promises.evidence: Domestic abuse and sexual offence reports continue to rise. No measurable progress.

promises.text: Devolve power with new deals for local areas
promises.evidence: English Devolution Bill introduced. Some new mayoral combined authorities. Lancashire CCA established.
No legislation introduced. Not in King's Speech. Appears dropped from agenda.
Hereditary peers removal passed. Full abolition not pursued. Reform proposed instead.
CCC says 2030 target now extremely challenging. Grid investment delayed. New gas licences approved.
Warm Homes Plan launched but budget cut from £6B to £3.4B. Only 200K homes insulated in first year.

promises.text: Bring water companies under special measures
promises.evidence: Water Bill introduced with new powers for Ofwat. Thames Water still in financial difficulty.
GDP growth 0.1% in 2025. Gilt yields hit 15-year high. OBR downgraded growth forecasts.

promises.text: Raise minimum wage to be a real living wage
promises.evidence: NLW rose to £12.21 in Apr 2026. Still below real living wage in many areas.
Grey belt policy introduced, releasing previously protected land. 200+ green belt sites identified.
Departments facing real-terms cuts from 2027. Councils issued S114 warnings. Unprotected departments cut 2%.

promises.text: Strengthen workers rights from day one
promises.evidence: Employment Rights Bill in parliament. Day-one rights for unfair dismissal proposed. Business pushback.
No appointment made. Role not established.
Football Governance Bill progressing through parliament.
Refused to scrap two-child benefit cap. Child poverty rose to 4.3M. Task force report delayed.
Not in legislative programme. Bishop Jones inquiry recommendations not implemented.
AI Opportunities Action Plan published. £14B data centre investment announced. Some progress.

promises.text: Make UK fastest growing G7 economy
promises.evidence: UK growth 0.1% in 2025 — slowest in G7 alongside Germany. IMF downgraded 2026 forecast.

promises.text: End hotel use for asylum seekers
promises.evidence: 30,000+ still in hotels. Cost £8M/day. Some closed but new ones opened elsewhere.
Average processing time still 12-18 months. Backlog reduced but still 80K+ cases.
SDR published but 2.5% target only aspirational, no timeline. Currently 2.3%.
Industrial Strategy published. 8 growth-driving sectors identified. Early stage.
Winter Fuel Payment means-tested from 2025. 10M pensioners lost payment. Excess winter deaths rose.
No review announced. UC frozen. Sanctions regime continued. No structural changes.
No new dentistry plan. Contract reform stalled. 6M+ unable to get NHS dentist.
No new centres announced. Existing family hubs underfunded.
Rough sleeping up 27% in annual count. Homelessness applications at record high.
UK-EU summit held May 2026. SPS agreement on food. Youth mobility scheme agreed.

promises.text: Reform planning to speed up infrastructure
promises.evidence: Planning and Infrastructure Bill in parliament. NSIP reforms proposed. Some acceleration.
De facto ban lifted but planning approvals still slow. No significant new capacity.
